review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Dv4 and formal Dv5 raw were independently compared.
review_views.notes: No usable broad relief hierarchy appears in either target field.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: Both target fields were inspected at 100%.
review_views.notes: The north-east remains especially uniform; the south-east also lacks a clear dominant and subordinate hierarchy.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Detailed crops were compared at 200% and 400%.
review_views.notes: Trees, rocks, road edges, paper grain, and hatch marks are regenerated or thickened.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: A nine-region scan covered the full raster.
review_views.notes: Water texture, coastline, city linework, forest, and fields drift outside the intended area.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: Generation and transfer masks were checked against the raw output.
review_views.notes: No obvious rectangular edge, but the raw edit does not respect outside-mask pixel identity.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Dv4 was treated as the authoritative parent.
review_views.notes: The raw output fails exact parent continuity.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: Edges and target boundaries were inspected.
review_views.notes: There is no discrete hard seam, but global redraw invalidates seam evidence.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Road and feature alignment were compared visually.
review_views.notes: Road centers are similar but their rendered edges no longer match exactly.

summary: Candidate D v5 is independently rejected. The raw output changes the complete map, while the robust broad signal remains below threshold in both regions. Atomic failure leaves the authoritative map unchanged.
required_changes: Generate a standalone featureless luminance delta plate and add only its bounded region-centered low-frequency field to Dv4; do not ask ImageGen to edit the detailed map.
